translations.translatedText: # Friday 19.10.2018 (radio)

The dispute over the dismissal law is getting tougher. New information about the Kuopio bus accident. The seizure at a Helsingin Sanomat journalist's home was legal. Chemicals are handled wrongly at small workplaces. Rainbow trout may become scarce. Boys are being encouraged to eat more vegetables.
The dispute over the dismissal law is getting tougher
![Strike guards at the Metso Minerals factory in Tampere on 3 October.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10442919)
Open image viewer
Next week there will be strikes at sawmills and plywood factories. Photo: Markku Ulander / Lehtikuva

The Industrial Union's strikes are spreading. Next week there will be strikes at companies that process wood. In addition, the Industrial Union is terminating agreements that were made about lengthening working hours. The government wants to make a law that makes dismissals easier in small firms. The Industrial Union does not want dismissals to be made easier.
## The driver of the Kuopio crash bus was driving too fast
![A coach crashed through a railing onto the railway track.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10370138)
Open image viewer
The bus was driving too fast and left the road. Photo: Jukka Eskanen / Yle

New information has been given about the Kuopio bus accident. Researchers say that the driver was tired and did not have much experience of the bus he was driving. There was no fault in the bus's brakes. The bus was driving too fast and left the road. The accident happened in Kuopio in August. Four passengers died and 22 were injured.
## A home search of the journalist's home was allowed
![Helsingin Sanomat article.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9982252)
Open image viewer
The journalist had appealed against the home search. Photo: Henrietta Hassinen / Yle

The court has decided that the seizure at the home of a Helsingin Sanomat journalist was legal. The Helsinki Court of Appeal decided that the police had the right to carry out a home search at the journalist's home. The police are investigating a story that Helsingin Sanomat wrote about the Army's signals test centre.
## Mistakes in handling chemicals
src="https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5286980"
Open image viewer
There were shortcomings in the right protective equipment used when handling chemicals. Photo: YLE Etelä-Karjala
Chemicals are handled wrongly at many small workplaces. The authorities' supervision found that, for example, car repair shops and laundries do not always know how to handle chemicals safely.
## No large rainbow trout fillets this year
![Pieces of rainbow trout.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-7328794)
Open image viewer
The fish have stayed smaller than usual. Photo: Jyrki Lyytikkä / Yle

There may be a shortage of rainbow trout. Fish farms are busy now. The fish have grown during the summer and are being lifted out and gutted. The warm summer was bad for the fish. The fish have stayed smaller than usual. Large salmon fillets cannot be made from rainbow trout.
## Boys are being encouraged to eat vegetables
![child washing carrots](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10449319)
Open image viewer
Sports clubs, where healthy food can be talked about with boys, are hoped to join in. Photo: AOP

Efforts are being made to get boys to eat more vegetables, fruit and berries. Many boys do not eat many vegetables. The Martha Organisation and the Finnish Independence Jubilee Fund are starting an information campaign called *Vegetables to the boys' table*. Sports clubs are hoped to join in. In sports clubs, healthy food can be talked about with boys.
